groups.Foundations / Icons: draws a glyph, picked by name.
groups.Primitives / Actions: something a reader presses or follows.
groups.Components / Cards: knows a product concept and renders one unit of it.
groups.Internal / Modules: code a component needs, with no markup of its own.
groups.Explorations / Kept: kept on purpose, marked @kept:, never counted as live.

tests.test: it is kept on purpose but not live, and marked with an @kept: line.
it draws nothing: a module or an endpoint.
it knows a product concept: a card, an order.
it is a glyph or a texture that draws nothing a reader operates.
it is a single-job part a reader presses or places content in.

notes: Foundations is asked before Primitives because an icon is a single-job part too.
